text: | Efficient Recycling | Your destroyed non-copy device; not deliberate sacrifice; debris within reach, after combat for one minute, 1/short rest. Refund at most min(1 RP, actual deployment RP). Enemy cause is **not required**. |

Recharge N sets a counter to N after use; reduce once at the start of the owner's regular initiative turn, whether able to act or not. Extra turns/Actions do not tick it. Outside combat tick once per 6 elapsed seconds, without double counting. Recharge 2 used on turn 1 is ready on turn 3. A positive counter can be reset/shortened at most once per ability per round. Zero counters are not legal reset targets and expend no reset use. Resets never restore RP or per-rest uses or grant an immediate activation.

Efficient Recycling refunds at most one RP actually paid to deploy the particular owned device, after its genuine enemy destruction and the feature's real one-minute/once-per-short-rest salvage procedure. GP construction, later repair RP and activation RP are not deployment costs: an ordinary crafted deployment paid0RP, so no refund is available from it. A quoted recipe value does not create paid RP.

KEEP actual enemy destruction, your own device, one minute after combat, once per short rest, consume its usable debris and return at most1RP actually paid to **deploy that same device**. Crafting GP, ingredients, dawn charges, service packs, encoding, field repairs, Dissonance routing and later Overcharge RP are not deployment RP. These43 crafted devices have no innate RP deployment cost, so they create **zero refundable deployment RP** through this card. Do not consume a valuable wreck merely by falsely asserting that its price is RP; admission must identify an actual eligible prior paid deployment. Deliberate sacrifice, copied objects and repeated debris claims do not qualify. No unspecified material salvage percentage is added by the class's legacy name.

**Blood Gauge maximum: 3; 6 with Spill Control.** Begin and end encounters at 0. Once on your regular turn, a weapon attack damaging a hostile living creature grants 1 BG; Hemorrhage Slash shares that trigger. All gains, including explicit refunds or critical/kill gains, total at most 2 per round. Staged, friendly and sacrificial sources do not qualify.

This new explicit gate ensures a later 5-BG Final Cut can be used without an optional capacity selection. Gain cap 2/round and encounter reset 0 still apply.
